title: Certificates of Deposit: Identifying the Add-On Already Made in the Current Term
content:
An in-term add-on to a certificate in the bank's Certificates of Deposit range is limited both in number and in total for each term. To apply those limits, the bank must know what has already been added in the term now running. This page defines that.

## Which earlier add-on counts

No tier permits two in-term add-ons within a single term. Any earlier add-on belonging to the running term is therefore the certificate's latest in-term add-on deposit entry, provided its posting date is on or after the start date of the current term. An in-term add-on posted before that start date belongs to an earlier term and does not count against the current one, either in number or in sum.

The current term is the one whose start date is on the certificate record. When a certificate starts a new term, that date moves to the new term's first day, and add-ons of the old term drop out of the count and out of the total.

## Effect on the limits

- **Count.** When an add-on of the current term exists, it uses one of the tier's in-term add-ons; the count is exhausted once the number of add-ons in the term has reached the tier's in-term add-on count. When none exists, the whole count is still available.
- **Term total.** Whatever the running term's earlier add-on brought in is deducted from the tier's total allowed for the term. When none exists, nothing is deducted.

## Input, judgement, outcome (hypothetical; a tier allowing one add-on per term)

| Current term start date | Latest in-term add-on entry | Counts in this term? | Count still available? | Deducted from the term total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 June 2026 | 1 August 2026, USD 10000.00 | Yes | No, exhausted | USD 10000.00 |
| 15 June 2026 | 3 February 2026, USD 10000.00 | No, earlier term | Yes | nothing |
| 15 June 2026 | none | nothing to count | Yes | nothing |
| 15 June 2026 | 15 June 2026, USD 4000.00 | Yes, posted on the start date | No, exhausted | USD 4000.00 |
